changelog: Fixed the Sort button not working in Music Player.
Fixed the Shuffle button not working.
Fixed the Playlist button not opening.
Fixed the Refresh Music button not working.
Fixed Share Nimiyo downloads failing or getting stuck when the Share window is closed too early.
Fixed downloads not appearing completely in download history, including multiple images downloaded in a single task or using Download All.
Improved playlist database storage reliability. Databases are now stored in Download/Nimiyo/Database.
Improved background downloads to prevent ongoing downloads from stopping unexpectedly.
Improved Nimiyo QuickSave background processing to prevent ongoing downloads from stopping unexpectedly.
